system.description:
+8 to [Magic Power]. Add +2 to the SR of your "Enhance Code" (may exceed maximum SR). Add the [Radiance] tag to your "Magic Missile". A gauntlet that can only be worn by those who have mastered all forms of magic and earned the title of Grand Magus. In reality, it is a refined version of the beginner's item, the Magician's Gauntlet, and the words "Even a master should not forget his beginning" are engraved upon it as a warning.

Diamond Powder [Core Material] (740G) + Magician's Gauntlet (380G) + Red Ring (1100G) + [Magic Catalyst 20] (370G) ×4 + Crafting Cost (1740G)
